kpis.name: Total Bookings
kpis.rationale: Count of reservations excluding cancelled bookings. Core volume metric for reservation activity. Uses fact_reservations with filter to exclude cancelled status. Aggregates by hotel, channel, segment and month.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.rationale: Sum of all folio charges including room and ancillary revenue. Comprehensive revenue measure across all charge types. Uses fact_folio_charges summing charge_amount. Aggregates by hotel, charge type and month. Currency conversion required per open question.

kpis.name: Occupancy %
kpis.rationale: Percentage of available rooms that are occupied. Calculated as rooms_sold / rooms_available from daily hotel performance records. Must use the same hotel-day performance records as ADR and RevPAR per requirement. Uses fact_daily_hotel_performance with denominator guard. Aggregates by hotel and month.

kpis.name: ADR (Average Daily Rate)
kpis.rationale: Average revenue per occupied room. Calculated as room_revenue / rooms_sold from daily hotel performance records. Must use the same hotel-day performance records as Occupancy % and RevPAR per requirement. Uses fact_daily_hotel_performance with denominator guard. Aggregates by hotel and month. Currency per open question.

kpis.name: RevPAR (Revenue Per Available Room)
kpis.rationale: Revenue per available room regardless of occupancy. Calculated as room_revenue / rooms_available from daily hotel performance records. Must use the same hotel-day performance records as Occupancy % and ADR per requirement. Uses fact_daily_hotel_performance with denominator guard. Aggregates by hotel and month. Currency per open question.

kpis.name: Cancellation %
kpis.numerator: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELLED' THEN reservation_id END)
kpis.rationale: Percentage of reservations that were cancelled. Ratio of cancelled reservations to total reservations. Uses fact_reservations with conditional count for numerator. Aggregates by hotel and month.

kpis.name: Average Stay
kpis.rationale: Average length of stay in nights for completed reservations. Mean of nights attribute across relevant reservations. Uses fact_reservations with filter to exclude cancelled. Aggregates by hotel and month. Open question on whether to include only CHECKED_OUT or also CONFIRMED and CHECKED_IN.

kpis.name: Repeat Guest %
kpis.numerator: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_repeat_guest = 1 THEN reservation_id END)
kpis.rationale: Percentage of reservations made by guests with prior stays. Calculated from is_repeat_guest flag on reservations. Uses fact_reservations with conditional count for numerator. Aggregates by hotel and month. Open question on how is_repeat_guest is determined.

kpis.name: No Show %
kpis.numerator: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(status, '[^A-Z0-9]', '')) IN ('NS','NOSHOW') THEN reservation_id END)
kpis.rationale: No-show uses the measured NS and NOSHOW-normalized reservation statuses; the denominator is all reservations at the reviewed grain.

kpis.name: Revenue by Channel
kpis.rationale: Total booking value attributed to each distribution channel for confirmed and checked-out bookings. Uses reservation total_amount, not folio charges. Uses fact_reservations with status filter. Aggregates by channel and month. Open question on whether CHECKED_IN should also be included and reporting currency.

kpis.name: Rooms Unsold
kpis.rationale: Count of available rooms that were not sold. Calculated as rooms_available minus rooms_sold. Uses fact_daily_hotel_performance with derived rooms_unsold measure from Silver Layer. Aggregates by hotel and month.

kpis.name: Average Review Score
kpis.rationale: Mean overall rating score from guest reviews. Calculated from rating attribute in reviews. Uses fact_reviews averaging rating measure. Aggregates by hotel and month.

facts.name: fact_reservations
facts.rationale: Core transactional fact for reservation lifecycle from booking through stay completion or cancellation. Grain is one row per reservation transaction identified by reservation_id. Includes derived flags is_cancelled, is_realised, and room_nights_booked from Silver Layer. Supports Total Bookings, Cancellation %, Average Stay, Repeat Guest %, No Show %, and Revenue by Channel KPIs.

facts.name: fact_daily_hotel_performance
facts.grain: One row per hotel per business day
facts.rationale: Pre-aggregated daily performance snapshot for hotel property. Grain is one row per hotel per business day identified by hotel_id + business_date. Source for Occupancy %, ADR and RevPAR KPIs which must use the same hotel-day performance records per requirement. Includes derived rooms_unsold measure from Silver Layer. Supports Occupancy %, ADR, RevPAR, and Rooms Unsold KPIs.

facts.name: fact_folio_charges
facts.rationale: Individual charge line item posted to reservation folio. Grain is one row per charge transaction identified by charge_id. Captures all revenue including room charges and ancillary services. Detailed grain for Total Revenue KPI. Supports Total Revenue KPI by summing charge_amount across all charge types.

facts.name: fact_stay_nights
facts.grain: One row per room per night of stay
facts.rationale: Individual night of guest occupancy in a specific room. Grain is one row per room per night of stay identified by hotel_id + room_id + stay_date + reservation_id. Finest grain for room revenue and occupancy measurement. Core fact for nightly revenue and occupancy analysis. Provides detailed stay-level data for reconciliation with daily_hotel_performance aggregates.

facts.name: fact_payments
facts.rationale: Payment transaction against reservation folio. Grain is one row per payment transaction identified by payment_id. Currently one-to-one with reservations in source data but model supports multiple payments per reservation. Provides payment method and status tracking for financial reconciliation.

facts.name: fact_reviews
facts.rationale: Guest satisfaction review submitted after stay. Grain is one row per review submission identified by review_id. Source for Average Review Score KPI. Provides overall rating and component scores for cleanliness, service and value. Supports Average Review Score KPI by averaging rating measure.

dimensions.name: dim_hotels
dimensions.rationale: Physical hotel property with operational configuration, location and brand attributes. Core dimension for all hotel operations and performance analysis. Grain is one row per hotel property identified by hotel_code. Provides geographic, brand and capacity context for all fact tables.

dimensions.name: dim_guests
dimensions.rationale: Individual customer with profile information. Master entity for guest relationship management and repeat guest identification. Grain is one row per unique guest identified by guest_ref. Includes derived guest_age_years from Silver Layer. Provides demographic context for reservation and review analysis.

dimensions.name: dim_channels
dimensions.rationale: Booking source or distribution channel with commission structure. Defines how reservations are acquired. Grain is one row per channel identified by channel_code. Provides distribution channel context for Revenue by Channel KPI and commission analysis.

dimensions.name: dim_market_segments
dimensions.rationale: Customer market segmentation category for business analysis and targeting. Grain is one row per market segment identified by segment_code. Provides market segment context for reservation analysis and revenue management.

dimensions.name: dim_rate_plans
dimensions.grain: One row per rate plan per hotel
dimensions.rationale: Pricing and terms package defining rate structure, meal inclusion and cancellation policy. Pricing dimension for revenue management. Grain is one row per rate plan per hotel identified by hotel_id + rate_plan_code. Provides pricing context for reservation analysis.

dimensions.name: dim_room_types
dimensions.grain: One row per room type per hotel
dimensions.rationale: Room category definition with physical characteristics, capacity and base pricing. Defines room product offering. Grain is one row per room type per hotel identified by hotel_id + room_type_code. Provides room category context for stay night and reservation analysis.

dimensions.name: dim_rooms
dimensions.rationale: Individual physical room unit within a hotel property. Inventory unit for room assignment and occupancy tracking. Grain is one row per physical room identified by hotel_id + room_number. Provides physical room context for stay night analysis.

dimensions.name: dim_loyalty_members
dimensions.rationale: Guest enrolled in loyalty program with tier status and points balance. Subset of guests with loyalty membership. Grain is one row per loyalty membership identified by membership_no. Provides loyalty program context for guest analysis.

exclusions.ota_feed_raw: Raw staging entity requiring transformation to reservation format. Not a reporting fact.
exclusions.cancellations: Cancellation events are represented as attributes and derived flags in fact_reservations. Separate cancellation fact not required for declared KPIs.
exclusions.pms_extract_log: Operational audit trail for PMS data extractions. Not a business fact for KPI reporting.
exclusions.batch_load_audit: Operational audit table for data loading processes. Not a business fact for KPI reporting.
exclusions.reservation_rooms: Bridge entity linking reservation to room assignment. Relationship represented through fact_reservations and fact_stay_nights. Separate bridge not required for declared KPIs.
exclusions.housekeeping_tasks: Operational fact for housekeeping performance tracking. Not required for declared 12 KPIs.
exclusions.room_inventory_daily: Daily room availability snapshot. Inventory measures are present in fact_daily_hotel_performance which is the approved source for Occupancy %, ADR and RevPAR KPIs per requirement.

open_questions: Currency-valued KPIs remain at source-currency grain because no approved FX source exists.
Repeat Guest % uses the approved is_repeat_guest business flag; the measured source contradiction remains recorded for remediation.

{{ config(
    materialized='incremental',
    unique_key='audit_id',
    incremental_strategy='merge',
    on_schema_change='append_new_columns'
) }}
-- Business: cleansed and standardised batch_load_audit.
-- Incremental: only rows with load_started_at beyond the last run's high-water mark are
-- read; they MERGE on audit_id. Nothing is deleted or truncated.
with source as (

    select * from {{ source('raw', 'batch_load_audit') }}
    {% if is_incremental() %} where load_started_at > (select coalesce(max(load_started_at), '1900-01-01'::timestamp) from {{ this }}) {% endif %}

)

select
        audit_id,
        batch_id,
        target_table,
        load_started_at,
        load_finished_at,
        rows_loaded,
        rows_rejected,
        status,
        source_system
from source
manifest.name: business_batch_load_audit

manifest.sql:
{{ config(
    materialized='incremental',
    unique_key='performance_id',
    incremental_strategy='merge',
    on_schema_change='append_new_columns'
) }}
-- Business: cleansed and standardised daily_hotel_performance.
-- Incremental: only rows with ingested_at beyond the last run's high-water mark are
-- read; they MERGE on performance_id. Nothing is deleted or truncated.
with source as (

    select * from {{ source('raw', 'daily_hotel_performance') }}
    where not (NOT (rooms_available > 0))
      and not (NOT (rooms_sold > 0))
      and not (NOT (rooms_available > 0))
      {% if is_incremental() %} and ingested_at > (select coalesce(max(ingested_at), '1900-01-01'::timestamp) from {{ this }}) {% endif %}

)

select
        performance_id,
        hotel_id,
        business_date,
        rooms_available,
        rooms_sold,
        rooms_out_of_order,
        arrivals,
        departures,
        source_system,
        ingested_at,
        batch_id,
        other_revenue,
        room_revenue,
        rooms_available - rooms_sold AS rooms_unsold
from source
manifest.name: business_daily_hotel_performance

-- Business: cleansed and standardised guests.

        guest_ref,
        REGEXP_REPLACE(full_name, '[A-Za-z0-9]', 'x', 3, 0) AS full_name,

        created_at,
        source_system,
        ingested_at,

from source

manifest.sql:
{{ config(
    materialized='incremental',
    unique_key='reservation_id',
    incremental_strategy='merge',
    on_schema_change='append_new_columns'
) }}
-- Business: cleansed and standardised reservations.
-- Incremental: only rows with booked_at beyond the last run's high-water mark are
-- read; they MERGE on reservation_id. Nothing is deleted or truncated.
with source as (

    select * from {{ source('raw', 'reservations') }}
    where not (NOT (status != 'CANCELLED'))
      and not (NOT (status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CHECKED_OUT')))
      {% if is_incremental() %} and booked_at > (select coalesce(max(booked_at), '1900-01-01'::timestamp) from {{ this }}) {% endif %}

)

select
        reservation_id,
        confirmation_no,
        hotel_id,
        guest_id,
        booked_at,
        check_in_date,
        check_out_date,
        nights,
        status,
        total_amount,
        channel_id,
        segment_id,
        rate_plan_id,
        adults,
        children,
        rooms_booked,
        currency,
        is_repeat_guest,
        source_system,
        ingested_at,
        batch_id,
        CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_cancelled,
        CASE WHEN status IN ('CHECKED_IN', 'CHECKED_OUT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_realised,
        rooms_booked * nights AS room_nights_booked
from source
manifest.name: business_reservations
